note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace (38 mm case, Irsyad); heights are the SNKM87K1 values (listed 12 mm thick). SEIKO, the 5 shield, the minute track, the print and the day-date wheel stay in the dial map.

crown.note: read from the straight photo (centre 19.4 mm right, 8.5 mm down)

end_link.note: the polished hood between the lugs, flush with the lug tips

bracelet.bend_note: Smooth curl like SUR419P1 (Irsyad, 2026-11-06): 7 mm radius from the lug tips (22.9 mm) to about 125 deg (end_y = tip + 2.2 R)

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers (model-viewer/three.js) render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

lume.note: cream lume inside the hour and minute hands

gold.note: pale yellow-gold plating of the batons, hands, hub and day-date frame, as photographed
